message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime. Facts: drunk driving. In Chinese criminal law, drunk driving causing dangerous driving is "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) under Article 133 of Criminal Law. If just drunk driving without causing accident, may be administrative. But criminal liability if blood alcohol >80 mg/100ml, driving motor vehicle, constitutes dangerous driving. So charge: 危险驾驶. According to correction rule: list statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So just "危险驾驶". No other crimes. Output format: [罪名]危险驾驶<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
